verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides SSH access management (Tailscale SSH handles authentication and authorization of SSH connections), so credential-storage security is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows it storing SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave or gating them with biometrics. Tailscale SSH and Tailnet Lock node signing are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics
